Afghanistan’s Rashid Khan became the first men’s player to claim 200 Twenty20 International wickets. | Photo Credit: PTI
Former Afghanistan captain Rashid Khan became ​the first bowler to claim ‌200 wickets in men's ​Twenty20 internationals on ⁠Thursday, reaching the milestone during Afghanistan's second T20 against Zimbabwe ‌in Sharjah.
* The leg-spinner brought up ‌the landmark when he ‌trapped ⁠Tadiwanashe Marumani lbw for ⁠two in the ninth over.
* Rashid achieved the feat in ​his 120th ‌T20 international, with the 28-year-old boasting an average of 13.96 and an ‌economy rate of 6.13 ​in the format. His record includes two ⁠five-wicket hauls, with best figures of 5-3.
* The Afghan ‌sits comfortably atop the list of leading wicket-takers in men's T20 internationals with 200 wickets, 39 clear of England's ‌Adil Rashid in second place.
* ​Rashid Khan became the first Afghanistan bowler to ⁠reach 200 ODI wickets during ⁠a match against Bangladesh in Abu Dhabi ‌in October last year.
